instruction: The average score of 8 students on a test is 72. After a ninth student takes the test the average of all 9 students becomes 73. What score did the ninth student get? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
